supporting_information.note: No same-paper SI was matched in the checked local inventories. This does not establish that no supplement exists elsewhere; no SI was joined to this review.

independent_audit: The complete six-page supplied main article was independently reviewed. The expanded audit findings T1-T3 have bounded correction coverage: T1 passed its targeted recheck, and T2/T3 passed the 2026-09-24 targeted independent recheck (18/18 checks). This closes those specified findings only; it is not an independent re-audit of every field, does not verify SI, and does not claim release or training approval.
audit_details: All six main-article pages and Figures 1–7 plus Table 1 were read and visually inspected. The Method-A route is kept distinct at 230, 250 and 270 °C. Figure 1 and Table 1 link sample A to 270 °C; the sample-specific hold time and selected Fe(III) alkoxide remain unresolved. T1 was cleared in its targeted recheck; T2 (cobalt-oxide control identity and unassigned phase) and T3 (B-specific author interpretation and XRD/Table 1 evidence) passed a separate targeted independent recheck. The paper’s literal “up to 300 K” wording remains in conflict with the 230-300 °C Method-A range. B-D remain observation-only because this article delegates their detailed procedures to other papers. No SI was located or verified, and no sample-specific coordinates/CIF are reported.
